items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Terminology 50:1
items.html: The Sefirot of Atik are called the days of old, because of the Malchut of the first restriction that serves in it. For in the world of correction, from Arich Anpin and below, this Malchut no longer serves, since it was concealed in RADLA, and only the Malchut of the second restriction serves in them — namely the one sweetened with the quality of mercy, as is known. Hence the Sefirot of Atik are called the days of old, that is, before the sweetening of the Malchut with the quality of mercy. And for this same reason he is called Adam Kadmon, because the Malchut of the first restriction is in him, which does not operate in the man of ABYA.
